name: Generalist Anomaly Detection (GAD) Benchmark
description: A benchmark encompassing anomaly detection across diverse datasets and domains including industrial defects, medical anomalies, and semantic anomalies. It evaluates models' ability to generalize anomaly detection without further training on target data, using few-shot normal images as sample prompts.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited community adoption so far, mainly appearing in the associated paper rather than as a standard evaluation suite.
notes: Includes nine datasets covering industrial, medical, and semantic anomalies; uses in-context residual learning with few-shot prompts.
